title: Concept: File access built from input (ruby) — review required
description: In ruby, File.read(dir + f) assembles a filesystem path from parts. Traversal payloads (..%2f, absolute paths, symlink races) redirect the operation outside its directory. The ruby-specific remedy is confinement via File.expand_path plus prefix check.
applicability: ruby codebases opening files with assembled paths; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Arbitrary file read or write when untrusted input reaches the path; HIGH severity because traversal payloads are trivial and impact is filesystem-wide.
